description: Discover GTFS, GTFS-Realtime, and GBFS feeds in the open-data registry. Filter by operator (Onestop ID), feed spec, fetch state, or a search term. Each feed returns its Onestop ID, spec, the fetch URL to download the data, the license terms (redistribution, commercial use, attribution, SPDX identifier where known), and last-fetch freshness (when it was retrieved and the calendar window it covers). Use this to answer "where do I get this agency's GTFS, and may I redistribute it?". Pass operator_onestop_id (from transitland_find_operators) to list exactly the feeds an operator publishes — the reliable way to a specific agency's feeds; spec also narrows that set. Returns the open-data catalog entry, not departures; for schedules see transitland_get_departures. Provide at least one filter.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (enrichment.cursor).

fetch_error.description: When true, return only feeds whose most recent fetch failed (stale/broken sources). When false, only successfully-fetched feeds. Omit for both. Useful for data-quality auditing.

limit.description: Maximum feeds to return. Values above 100 apply the 100-result page cap with a notice. Page further with the after cursor.

operator_onestop_id.description: Restrict to feeds published by this operator (Onestop ID, e.g. "o-9q9-bart"). The reliable way to find a specific agency's feeds — get the ID from transitland_find_operators.

search.description: Full-text search over feed names and identifiers (e.g. "511 Regional", "MBTA"). Useful when you know a feed by name but not its operator.

spec.description: Filter by feed spec. "gtfs" = static schedule data; "gtfs-rt" = real-time (trip updates, vehicle positions, alerts); "gbfs" = bikeshare/micromobility; "mds" = mobility data spec. Omit to return all specs. The API accepts both lowercase ("gtfs-rt") and uppercase ("GTFS_RT") on input; the output spec is always uppercase (GTFS, GTFS_RT, GBFS, MDS).

name: transitland_find_feeds

cursor.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page. Present only when more results exist.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_filter`: No operator_onestop_id, spec, search, or fetch_error filter was provided (server-enforced guard — the upstream API accepts unfiltered requests but returns a global firehose). `operator_not_found`: operator_onestop_id was provided but no operator exists for it (feeds are resolved from the operator record). `rate_limited`: Transitland returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

feeds.description: Matching feeds with fetch URLs, license terms, and freshness.

items.description: A matching feed with fetch URL, license, and freshness.

authorizationRequired.description: True when fetching the feed itself needs a separate API key/registration (the fetchUrl alone is insufficient).

fetchUrl.description: Direct URL to download the current feed data (the GTFS .zip for static feeds; the realtime endpoint for GTFS-RT/GBFS). Null when the registry has no current URL.

latestFetch.description: Freshness of the current feed version. fetchedAt long in the past or latestServiceDate near today signals stale data.

earliestServiceDate.description: Earliest calendar date the current data covers (YYYY-MM-DD).

fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent successful fetch (data freshness).

latestServiceDate.description: Latest calendar date the current data covers — when service data runs out.

sha1.description: Content hash of the fetched feed version.

license.description: License/terms as recorded by Transitland. Empty registry fields are normalized to "unknown" or null — never fabricated. Confirm against the license url before redistributing.

redistributionAllowed.description: Whether redistribution is permitted. "unknown" when the registry has no value — surface honestly, do not assume permissive.

spdxIdentifier.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g. "CC-BY-4.0") when the registry knows it. Null/unknown is common — do not infer a license that is not stated.

url.description: URL of the license or terms-of-use document.

useWithoutAttribution.description: Whether attribution can be omitted. "no"/"unknown" implies attribute the source.

name.description: Feed name. Often null for single-operator feeds.

onestopId.description: Feed Onestop ID (e.g. "f-9q9-bart"). The durable handle for this feed.

realtimeUrls.description: Real-time endpoints when the feed carries GTFS-RT. All null for a static-only GTFS feed.

tripUpdates.description: GTFS-RT trip-updates endpoint (delays/predictions). Non-null implies this feed powers real-time departures.

spec.description: Feed spec: GTFS, GTFS_RT, GBFS, or MDS.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit.

title: transitland-mcp-server: find feeds
